name: Disable Cutscene Dialog
description: Skips the conversation-panel cutscenes that play between fights, before bosses, and after victories. Works at two layers: (1) forces Book:HasPanCompleteDialog and Book:HasVictoryCompleteDialog (base class) to return false, and (2) neutralizes the per-book story handlers Book{1,2,3}:OnVictoryComplete and OnPanComplete, which call convpanel.Activate() directly (gated by NeedsStageTutorial, NOT by the base gates) and are the actual source of the early-chapter dialogs. All targeted handlers are pure dialog (verified: no treasure/state writes), so returning early is safe. NOT removed: the once-per-chapter intro tutorials in InitialTilesDone (chapter 1 'Whoa where am I', chapter 5/6 intros -- left intact because chapter 6's branch is the only thing that unlocks gems), and the inter-book CutsceneLoop story scenes and in-battle word-bubble taunts. Because this skips the conversation that normally unlocks the level-up bar, it also sets AllowXPBar from the start so leveling keeps working (same effect as the enable_xp mod).
author: you
